configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: The one build tree. Ninja, Homebrew LLVM clang, project defaults. There is deliberately no second preset: sanitizers, build types and option overrides are -D flags you pass when you want them, not parallel trees that drift out of sync. Do NOT delete build/ to 'apply' this preset — it exists so `cmake --preset default` reproduces the same configuration.
